movie_title: Can jellyfish help us solve our problems? 6 Minute English
introduction:
Improve your English vocabulary and listening in just six minutes!
Scientific research is discoverin
lead_intro: Discover the fascinating world of jellyfish and their potential solution to plastic pollution in the seas in this 6 Minute English program by BBC Learning English.

quiz.question: What is the best way to treat jellyfish stings?
quiz.explanation: Vinegar is the best way to treat jellyfish stings as it inactivates the sting's venom.

quiz.question: What is the name of the European research team of jellyfish ecologists looking into the problem of microplastics?
quiz.explanation: The European research team of jellyfish ecologists looking into the problem of microplastics is called Go Jelly.

quiz.question: What is the name of the BBC World Service program that Dr. Ana Rotter speaks to about microplastics?
choices: a) People Talking about the World
quiz.explanation: Dr. Ana Rotter speaks to the BBC World Service program 'People Fixing the World' about microplastics.

quiz.question: What does Dr. Rotter mention was more common when she was a child regarding single-use plastics?
quiz.explanation: When Dr. Rotter was a child, cloth bags were commonly used instead of single-use plastic bags.

quiz.question: What does jellyfish mucus act as in relation to microplastic waste in the sea?
quiz.explanation: Jellyfish mucus acts like a magnet for microplastic waste, trapping the tiny pieces of floating plastic.
